    <bpmn:task id="t_generate" name="Generate the ticket" />
    <bpmn:task id="t_send" name="Send the ticket by email or SMS" />

    <bpmn:task id="t_inventory" name="Update the seat inventory" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f5" sourceRef="t_generate" targetRef="t_send" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f6" sourceRef="t_send" targetRef="p_split" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f7" sourceRef="p_split" targetRef="t_inventory" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f8" sourceRef="p_split" targetRef="t_reminders" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f9" sourceRef="t_inventory" targetRef="p_join" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f15" sourceRef="t_feedback" targetRef="end_feedback" />
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
